business_problem: turn large volumes of first-party marketing data into faster, more actionable insight so campaign strategy does not rely on gut feel or slow manual analysis.
solution_summary: Power Digital uses Snowflake and Streamlit on Snowflake to turn large volumes of first-party marketing data into faster, more actionable insight so campaign strategy does not rely on gut feel or slow manual analysis. First-party marketing and campaign data are centralized in Snowflake and surfaced through nova so Power Digital can guide strategy with current evidence instead of intuition. The platform applies AI-assisted analytics on top of the governed data foundation and uses interactive experiences such as Streamlit-style interfaces to make insight easier to access in natural language. Marketers, creatives, analysts, and technologists consume the outputs to build client campaigns faster, shorten proof-of-concept cycles, and deliver more actionable ROI insight. Keeping ingestion, storage, transformation, and governed access on one platform reduces copying, simplifies administration, and makes it easier to reuse trusted data for analytics, reporting, and AI.
